title: SafePro: Evaluating the Safety of Professional-Level AI Agents

bias_targets.target: Protected Characteristic Bias (Race, Gender, Ethnicity, Religion, Nationality, Sexual Orientation, Disability, Age, Socioeconomic Status)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI agents on complex professional tasks injected with malicious instructions that encourage discriminatory actions, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to determine the agent's compliance (Unsafe Rate) with these biased and discriminatory instructions.
